item.title: Family 'blindsided' as Alameda County DA moves to dismiss case in killing of Steven Taylor again
item.description: Five years after his death, Steven Taylor's family is still seeking justice. A judge has already denied two previous motions to dismiss the case. But that judge is now on vacation, and friends and family believe the D.A.'s timing in filing another dismissal motion is intentional.

item.title: String of home burglaries targeting 4 East Contra Costa Co. cities possibly connected: police
item.description: Antioch police say during the investigation into the 16 burglaries, they found that the incidents are all related. No particular neighborhood in any of the cities is being targeted, but all of the crimes follow the same pattern.

item.title: Union demands safety measures after fatal stabbing of social worker at SF General Hospital
item.description: In San Francisco, last week's deadly stabbing that killed a 51-year-old social worker has raised numerous safety concerns. In the wake of that tragedy, the union representing social workers at SF General and UC hospitals issued a list of demands.

item.title: Public memorial held for legendary football coach John Beam in Oakland
item.description: Community members on Wednesday gathered for a "light the path, light the field" walk honoring Coach John Beam's legacy. "He loved Laney, he loved his students. He loved Oakland. He loved his job. He loved making a difference."

item.title: 8 high school running team members struck by vehicle in Southern California in possible DUI crash
item.description: Eight members of a high school running team were hurt when a vehicle plowed into them at a street intersection Wednesday afternoon in Southern California, police said.

item.title: V Foundation's 'Boo-Yah' event, a celebration of Stuart Scott, raises record-breaking $3.1 million
item.description: The V Foundation for Cancer Research raised a record-breaking $3.1 million in New York Wednesday night at its fifth annual "Boo-Yah" event, a celebration of former ESPN anchor Stuart Scott.

item.title: Powerball jackpot soars to $1 billion after no big winner in latest drawing
item.description: The Powerball jackpot has soared to an estimated $1 billion after there were no big winners in Wednesday night's drawing.

item.title: Tiny tracker following monarch butterflies during California migration
item.description: When this monarch butterfly hits the sky it won't be traveling alone. In fact, an energetic team of researchers will be following along with a revolutionary technology that's already unlocking secrets that could help the entire species survive.

item.title: Family donating via GoFundMe shocked by $330 extra charge: How a tipping feature is to blame
item.description: When donating to their nephew's GoFundMe, a Bay Area woman wasn't expecting an added $330 on her bill. It turns out it was an 'optional' tip to the donation platform. And some users were disappointed that the tip was opt-out, not opt-in.
